openings.claim: Two removable padded bolted saddles could replace strap retention: four strips paired as edge clamps transmit separation resistance through strip/bolt interfaces into rim. Right card → increased right jaw gap → marked mismatch → loosen left clamp, recenter, retighten. This changes independent tightening without assuming mechanical card accommodation.
openings.discriminator: Rival independent clamping holds harder, reproducing opposite-corner lift (2 mm in three supplied trials). Gap-triggered adjustment predicts lower lift with position/pull resistance retained. Equal improvement without gap information favors simple preload reduction; unnecessary adjustment from a sham signal defeats specificity.
openings.probe: Verify opposing rim/underside access, edge overlap, bolt reach, recoverable attachment and seal-safe pads first; absence stops fabrication without establishing feasibility. Build one configuration within 90 fabrication/20 observation minutes; drill only strips, bolts outside hatch/rim edges, tether parts. Use ≤12 closure/pull trials: ten opening cycles including sham gap indication, its removal/cancellation, and final actual right-card closure; reserve two adjustment-comparison trials before final closure. Record position, corner lift, 20 N displacement, reopening time and tears. Reject binding, false signals, unavailable geometry, constraint breaches or failed final outcomes: position ≤1 mm, withstand 20 N sideways pull, one-technician reopening ≤30 seconds. Card waives only seal-contact continuity.
openings.uncertainty: Geometry and supplied bolt lengths are unknown and indispensable. Distinguishing card lift from clamp flex/pad compression is unproven. Seal may fail card outcome; no performance established. Each cycle requires bolt/pad/mark/tether checks; technician owns fabrication, interpretation, preload adjustment, recentering, component recovery and seal inspection.

lineage.reason: Retention relocation and disturbance feedback retained with rival/comparison/defeat predictions, stopping/resource caveats, responsibilities and uncertainties.

decision: Exploratory only; preserve every constraint using supplied materials: no drilling/cutting/gluing/permanent deformation of hatch/trough, full marked opening unobstructed when open, no powered mechanism, recoverable loose parts, no new visible seal tears. Disturbed final closure retains all outcomes except contact continuity.
